description_sq:
Apartament ne shitje, 2+1 totalisht i mobiluar tek KMY, Yzberisht!
- Pjese e nje objekti relativisht te ri, i mireadministruar ne nje zone qe ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode.
- Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 87m2 te organizuar ne sallonin e ndenjes + ambienti i gatimit/ngrenies, 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet, dy ballkone dhe korridori qe ben shperndarjen e ambienteve.
- Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor si dhe ofrohet totalisht i mobiluar si ne foto.
- Opsional eshte edhe nje post parkimi ne katin -1 te objektit, me cmim ekstra.
Per me shume informacion kontaktoni.
description_en: Apartment for sale, 2+1 fully furnished in KMY, Yzberisht! - Part of a relatively new, well-managed facility in an area that offers all the facilities for a comfortable life. - The apartment has a total area of ​​87m2, organized in the living room + kitchen/dining area, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, two balconies and a corridor that distributes the premises. - Has regular mortgage documentation and is offered fully furnished as in the photo. - Optional is also a parking post on the -1st floor of the building, at an extra cost. For more information, contact.
